skills.name: Ninja Kick! (忍兔飞踢！/忍兎飛踢!)
skills.description: SP Yama Usagi gets serious and launches a 2-strike attack on a single target twice, dealing damage equal to 50% of her ATK with each strike.

skills.name: Ninja Formation! (梦心迷兔阵！/夢心迷兎降!)
skills.line: Heroes never turn back to watch an explosion!!
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
SP Yama Usagi places 3 Ninja Mines by the enemy's feet. When a Ninja Mines is detonated, and if she is not inflicted with Banish and similar effects or by a control effect, she uses Ninja Dance!! and gains 1 chapter of Ninja Tricks.
Whenever non-summoned enemies take 6 turns, 1 control effect will be dispelled from SP Yama Usagi. If she is not inflicted with a control effect and is not immobile, this skill is automatically used once to place 2 Ninja Mines without any onibi. ;Ninja Mines (迷兔炸弹/迷兎爆弾) : :Max of 9 can be placed. Place on the move bar is locked on the 50% position. A mine is detonated when an enemy passes by them on the move bar, dealing damage equal to 120% of SP Yama Usagi's ATK. A mine is removed after it's detonated. ;Ninja Tricks (梦忍法/夢忍法) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max of 9 chapters. Each time 1 chapter is used, the damage for Ninja Scurrying Steps! is increased by 20%. After using that skill, all chapters of Ninja Tricks are consumed.

upgrades.text: '''Ninja Mines''': Damage dealt also ignores 150 defense.
'''Ninja Mines''': When a mine detonates, also decreases the target's resist by 30%.
Number of enemy turns needed to activate this skill without onibi decreases to 5.

skills.name: Ninja Dance!! (兎忍舞!!)
skills.description: SP Yama Usagi increases the move bar for all allies by 10% and increases their ATK by 10%, lasts for 2 turns.

skills.name: Ninja Scurrying Steps! (狩梦之乱舞！/狩夢の乱舞!)
skills.line: Behold possibly the most ultimate skill of Rabbit Ninja Tricks!
skills.description: SP Yama Usagi has a 10% base chance to inflict 1 enemy with Morph. Then she summons mines to attack all enemies, dealing damage equal to 160% of her ATK. ;Ninja Mines (迷兔炸弹/迷兎爆弾) : :Max of 9 can be placed. Place on the move bar is locked on the 50% position. A mine is detonated when an enemy passes by them on the move bar, dealing damage equal to 120% of SP Yama Usagi's ATK. A mine is removed after it's detonated.

upgrades.text: Using this skill increases her HIT by 30% (lasts for 2 turns).
Using this skill also places 1 Ninja Mine.

bio.condition: Team SP Yama Usagi with another player's Yama Usagi and clear any zone 10 times.
Increase SP Yama Usagi's skills 12 times.
With SP Yama Usagi win 30 times in PVP, Practice or Spar.
